subject: Request to rework demo — additional stakeholders added (security / infra / procurement)
messages:

Cc: Elena Morris <elena.morris@bluepeak.com>, procurement@bluepeak.com
Date: 2027-06-02T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: expand demo to include security + procurement — need alternate dates

Hi Kimberly,

Quick note — after an internal sync this morning, we need to expand the demo to include our Security, Infrastructure and Procurement leads. Several folks are traveling the week of June 7 and procurement needs extra time to evaluate contract terms. Can we move the demo out of that week and plan for a two-part session (tech deep-dive + procurement/governance)?

Prefer windows: June 15–17 (security available all three days) or June 16 (procurement prefers the 16th). Timezone: PT.

Also sharing a short list of people to include: Elena Morris (Sec), Rajiv Patel (Infra), and procurement@bluepeak.com.

Apologies for the change — we want the right people in the room. Let me know what works and if you want a split session.

Thanks,
Tom Reeves
Director of Platform Partnerships
BluePeak Health

Attachments: none
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com

Date: 2027-06-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: expand demo to include security + procurement — need alternate dates

Tom — thanks for the heads up and the roster. Totally reasonable to include those teams. A couple quick things so we can scope the session properly:

- Do you want one contiguous two-hour session (we'll do tech + security + procurement in sequence) or two separate blocks (60–75m tech/integration + 45m procurement/governance)?
- Can you confirm Rajiv Patel's email for infra invite?
- Are any attendees strict on date/time other than the procurement preference for the 16th?

Suggested options (PT):
- Option A: June 15, 09:00–11:00 (two-hour contiguous)
- Option B: June 16, 09:00–10:15 (tech) + 11:00–11:45 (procurement) — gives a short break for internal coordination

I've attached an updated agenda (redwood-demo-agenda-v4.pdf) that includes the new security checklist section. Marissa and Vivek are looped in for technical coverage and to advise on splitting. If we go two-part we can send separate calendar invites.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Partnerships (West)
Redwood Inference

Confirmed attendees:
- Elena Morris (Security Lead) — elena.morris@bluepeak.com

Kim / Vivek — quick internal note after reviewing the agenda and attendee list:

Proposal (to send to BluePeak):
- Split into two focused blocks on June 16 (PT):
  1) 09:00–10:15 — Technical/integration (Vivek, Jonas, Sergio to cover runtime, KV caching, VPC flows)
  2) 11:00–11:45 — Procurement / governance (Marissa + Kim to cover SLA / pricing / contract path)

Rationale: keeps the technical deep-dive uninterrupted, gives procurement a concise slot to discuss terms, and avoids a single long meeting that won't work with travel schedules.

I've attached the security checklist we'll walk through in the tech session (security-checklist_2027-06.xlsx) and a short integration runbook (integration-runbook-summary.docx). If BluePeak still wants a contiguous session, we can offer June 15, 09:00–11:00 as a fallback.

Action items before sending to customer:
- Kim: confirm and send calendar invites for the two slots (please include agenda and attachments).
- Vivek/Jonas/Sergio: flag any topics that need >20 minutes so we can adjust the tech slot.

-Marissa
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
